$comment: Initial Indonesian (id) content for the Blog template. Single-type schemas (site-settings, menu) map to an object; collection schemas (post, page) map to an ARRAY of entries. seedTemplate() PUTs singles to /content/single/{slug} and POSTs each collection entry to /content/collection/{slug}. {{PLACEHOLDERS}} are substituted at provisioning time (e.g. SITE_NAME).
